Сервер хранит адрес электронной почты, д: The server stores the email address, registration and last-activity dates, sign-in count, and numerical counts of projects, tasks, and synchronized events. When an Android APK download is requested from a signed-in account, we store the number and dates of those requests; anonymous or direct downloads cannot be linked to an account. When the Android app contacts the server, it reports its version and a random installation ID; the server stores the time of the last contact and the outcome of the last sync attempt without task content. Only the administrator sees this information, and it is deleted with the account. A reported version does not prove that the app is still installed. The administrator cannot see task names, descriptions, notes, tags, or content.

Почему наш год начинается в день весенне: Why does our year begin on the vernal equinox? Why does each month contain exactly 30 days divided into six ‘quintas’ (five-day periods), while the year has 12 months plus a ‘hidden’ thirteenth month?
Это не случайность. Это классическая сак: This is no coincidence. It is the classical sacred geometry of time, where every day is a step in the evolution of spirit. Let us explore this structure through the lens of the ancient theology of Pythagoras, Hesiod, and Homer.

20 марта — это точка преодоления инерции: March 20 is the point at which winter's inertia is overcome. It is the first day of the month of Areios (Ares), a time of breakthrough, of separating being from non-being, and of light's victory over darkness. The 12 months form a complete solar circle: the perfect cycle of an idea's development, from its birth in spring to its complete dissolution into the void (Zophos) at winter's end. The remaining 5–6 days of the year are Apeiron, a time of pure Chaos outside time, when the old world has collapsed and the new one has not yet been born.

Каждая Пята (5 дней) — это микрокосм, от: Each Quinta (five days) is a microcosm reflecting the soul's ‘Anabasis’ (ascent) from dense matter to pure light. The days follow a strict order: Earth — Water — Air — Fire — Aether. Why this order?
Мир строится от стабильного к тонкому. З: The world is built from the stable toward the subtle. Earth is stasis (the cube), Water is fluidity, and Air is form. Fire stands above Air because Air is passive while Fire is active: it transforms the elements and overcomes gravity. Aether is quintessence, the crown of creation.
В его «Теогонии» путь творения идёт от т: In his ‘Theogony,’ creation proceeds from heaviness toward radiance. First come Chaos and solid Earth (Gaia), then Water (Pontus) emerges from her, Earth is covered by Sky (Air / Uranus), and only afterward pure Light (Aether) is born. Fire is the gods' instrument, standing above the elements.
Иерархия строится на жребии богов. Аид п: The hierarchy is established by the gods' allotment. Hades received the underworld (Earth), Poseidon the sea (Water), and Zeus the high sky (Air and Aether). Movement always proceeds from below upward.

Для пифагорейцев 6 — это первое совершен: To the Pythagoreans, six was the first perfect number (1 + 2 + 3 = 6), the number of the ‘creation of the world’ and harmony. The word ‘Apeiron’ means ‘Boundless.’ These are the 5–6 sacred intercalary days before the vernal equinox. During them, the laws of the 12 months cease to operate. There are neither Quintas nor a strict hierarchy of elements.

Без выбранного вручную города Android об: When no city is selected manually, Android contacts GeoJS. That service sees your IP address and returns approximate coordinates and a time zone.
